errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate pie charts, not a single one. The description treats them as a single chart, leading to numerous subsequent errors.
The description fails to mention the existence and purpose of the second pie chart, which is titled 'Класификация по размер на похарчените средства' (Classification by amount of funds spent).
In the left chart (by number of reports), the largest segment is 'Провали' (Failures) with 438 reports, not 'Некласифицирани' (Unclassified) with 340 reports.
The 'Некласифицирани' (Unclassified) segment is grey, not blue.
The 'Провали' (Failures) segment is red, not green.
The 'Успехи' (Successes) segment is light green, not red.

errors.text_span: Всяка част от диаграмата показва количествена информация за броя на случаите, особено за „Некласифицирани“ с 37,8 млрд. лв., „Провали“ с 82,6 млрд. лв. и „Успехи“ с 35,5 млрд. лв.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely confuses the two charts. It claims to describe the 'броя на случаите' (number of cases) from the left chart but then lists the monetary values (in billions of BGN) from the right chart.
The value for 'Успехи' (Successes) in the right chart is 35.3 billion BGN, not 35.5 billion BGN.
